origin.description: Send cat() to a file until the frame exits.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: File path or an open text file.

arguments.name: split
arguments.text: Accepted. R would also copy the text to the previous sink.

origin.details: Passing None is an error. Extra sinks opened inside the block are removed on the way back, with a warning.

translation.description: Send cat() to a file until the frame exits.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: File path or an open text file.

arguments.name: split
arguments.text: Accepted. R would also copy the text to the previous sink.

translation.details: Passing None is an error. Extra sinks opened inside the block are removed on the way back, with a warning. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
with local_output_sink(path):
    cat("hello\n")
with open(path) as handle:
    text = handle.read().splitlines()[0]
os.remove(path)
return text
